_schema_name: LNES-60 Phase 2 LNES-22 Action Authority Schemas
_purpose: Canonical schemas for the LNES-22 action-authority layer in the LNES-60 Phase 2 context. Three sub-schemas: MissionRequest (input), AuthorizationDecision (output), and the handshake payload passed from the physical-truth layer to LNES-22.
_boundary_rule: The physical-truth resolution layer (xLMP+LNES-60) determines WHAT IS TRUE about the aircraft. LNES-22 determines WHAT IS PERMITTED given that truth and the mission request. These are separate evaluations. A physically healthy aircraft may be held if the mission is unauthorized.
_information_minimization: The handshake payload from physical-truth to LNES-22 contains only the resolved state — NOT raw evidence, raw sensor values, raw documentary text, or model reasoning. LNES-22 must not re-evaluate physical evidence; it must consume already-resolved state.
_no_neurolock_in_phase2: NEURO-LOCK actuation commands are NOT issued in Phase 2. Local simulation only.

MissionRequest._description: Request to authorize an aircraft mission. Submitted to LNES-22 alongside the resolved Aircraft State Object.

aircraft_id.description: Must match the Aircraft State Object's aircraft_id.

configuration_epoch.description: Configuration epoch the mission is authorized against. Must match the Aircraft State Object.

requested_action.description: Specific action being requested (e.g. PREFLIGHT_RELEASE, MOTOR_ARM, TAKEOFF_AUTHORIZE).

operational_conditions_ref.description: Reference to operational conditions specification (weather, site, time window).

authorization_policy_version.description: Version of the engineering envelope policy being applied.

mission_within_envelope.description: Pre-evaluated flag: has the mission profile been checked against the authorized configuration envelope? True means the mission parameters fall within the authorized range for this aircraft/configuration. LNES-22 validates this against the policy version.

mission_envelope_reason.description: Human-readable explanation if mission_within_envelope is false. Empty string if true.

PhysicalTruthHandshakePayload._description: Minimal payload from the physical-truth layer to LNES-22. Contains only what LNES-22 needs — no raw evidence, no model reasoning.

release_decision.description: The engineering release decision from release_policy.py.

resolved_predicate.description: The physical predicate that was evaluated.

contributing_planes.description: Which evidence planes contributed to the resolution.

conflict_detail.description: Conflict information if resolution_state is DOCUMENT_PHYSICAL_CONFLICT, SENSOR_CONFLICT, or CONFIGURATION_MISMATCH. Null otherwise. Contains type and reason_codes only, not raw evidence values.

state_envelope_root.description: provenance_root from the Aircraft State Object. Enables LNES-22 to verify it is consuming the correct state version.

PhysicalTruthHandshakePayload._excluded_fields: raw sensor values, raw documentary text, model reasoning chains, private keys, calibration data

AuthorizationDecision._description: Output of LNES-22 action-authority evaluation. This is the final release or hold decision, combining physical truth with mission authorization.

decision_id.description: Unique decision identifier for audit purposes.

action_authority.description: RELEASE: both physical state and mission authorization pass. HOLD: either physical state or mission authorization prevents release. INCOMPLETE: insufficient information to decide.

reason_codes.description: Explanation of HOLD or INCOMPLETE decisions. Empty for RELEASE.

physical_truth_verdict.description: The resolution_state and release_decision from the handshake payload, preserved for audit.

mission_authorization_verdict.description: Whether the mission was within the authorized configuration envelope.

decision_receipt.description: SHA-256 of the canonical serialization of this decision record, for tamper-evident audit.
